status: UNDER CONSTRUCTION — no vocabulary, no verified facts. Not ready to answer callers.
description: Developer cookbook for the Learnosity Data API — the server-to-server interface to a Learnosity item bank. The client describes a data job (endpoint, action, request), and L0178 returns a host-language-neutral recipe: how to sign the request, how to page the result set to completion, how to read the response envelope, and how to verify the job did what was intended. Documentation-only: it never calls a Learnosity API, holds no credentials, and emits no runnable code. It does NOT author item content (that is L0176) and does NOT cover the Author API authoring experience (that is L0177). Use ONLY when the user names Learnosity.
